# xplor `+brick` package — no licence file

The `+brick` functions are from the **xplor** toolbox (https://github.com/XplorMatlab/xplor),
which MLspike requires. The copy this pipeline ran carried no licence file, so the functions
are included here unmodified, with this provenance note. They are **not** covered by this
repository's MIT licence. Keep `thirdparty/explor` (not `+brick` itself) on the MATLAB path.
